operator_io_quirks: Mixed-case table/column names (Customer_Master_Index, cmi_cross_ref_id) — must double-quote; column lookup case-insensitive.
Tiny tables (2-21 rows) — original_values sampling k=min(5,len) yields near-full coverage; no huge-table path exercised.
All columns declared INTEGER or VARCHAR(255)/CHAR(15); no Date/Time/Bool/Bit/Year dispatch, no crash-fallback types.
CHAR(15) source_system_code dispatches to String(length=15) via char family; VARCHAR(255) also String(length=255).
All storage classes match declared types (integer/text); no affinity contradictions.
All FKs point to existing parents (parent_exists true); no dangling FKs, no self-references, no composite PKs.

FK child cmi_cross_ref_id values in leaf tables (e.g. 101,103,99,81) exceed parent CMI_Cross_References distinct range (21) — original data itself has orphan-looking values, but pragma says parent exists; FK consistency in TS will draw from parent's generated values, not these.
master_customer_id in CMI_Cross_References has distinct=6 < 21 rows — non-unique FK parent column (many-to-one).
source_system_code distinct=6 over 21 rows — heavy duplication; String sampler will mostly reuse elements.
cmi_details VARCHAR(255) holds company names with commas/periods/hyphens — String CHARSET lacks these, contamination adds random chars.
All PKs single-column INTEGER NOT NULL; no NOT NULL/CHECK constraints beyond PK.
DDL has no indexes/views/triggers; empty clone is just 8 CREATE TABLEs.
operator_ts_expectations: All columns use Number fuzzer (INTEGER) or String fuzzer (VARCHAR/CHAR); no Date/Time/Bool paths.
Number fuzzer: scale=0, range [-1,1] for INTEGER (10^0); int perturbation +-1/+-2; fresh draws mostly 0/1/-1 — implausible for IDs like 101,103.
String fuzzer for source_system_code: length range [min,max+1] from elements (5-9 chars), CHARSET a-zA-Z0-9() — will not reproduce 'Rent','Parking' exactly but reuses elements w.p. 1-p.
String fuzzer for cmi_details: reuses company-name elements plus contamination; fresh strings lack commas/periods.
FK fill: leaf cmi_cross_ref_id drawn from CMI_Cross_References.cmi_cross_ref_id final values (Number-generated, small ints) — consistent but tiny domain.
choose_table_sizes: level-0 Customer_Master_Index gets 1+30u (~1-31), each next level x4 capped 2500 — leaf tables may get hundreds of rows vs original 2-6.
PK dedup keeps first occurrence; with Number range [-1,1] and n>3, many PK collisions dropped — final row counts shrink drastically.

Likely FN driver: Number fuzzer produces 0/1/-1 for IDs, so joins on cmi_cross_ref_id match but values implausible; queries filtering e.g. cmi_cross_ref_id>50 return empty in TS but non-empty in original.

Likely FP driver: original leaf tables have cmi_cross_ref_id values (101,99,81) not in parent's 21 rows — original itself has join misses; TS's consistent FK fill makes joins succeed where original fails, flipping empty/non-empty.
Non-unique master_customer_id (6 distinct/21) — TS Number fill from parent's 9 values with replacement reproduces duplication naturally.
source_system_code heavy duplication (6/21) — String element reuse w.p. 1-p reproduces ties; fresh strings break them.
Small tables mean original_values nearly exhaust elements; p=0.2 fresh-draw rate still injects implausible strings/ints.
